blocks.text: Viruses ko jandar (organisms) nahi mana jata kyunke yeh acellular hain, yani cells se bane hue nahi. In mein zindagi ke teen domains ki koi khasoosiyat nahi, is liye inhein kisi domain ya kingdom mein nahi rakha jata.

blocks.title: Prions aur viroids
blocks.text: Prions aur viroids bhi acellular hain, aur inhein bhi zinda jandar nahi mana jata. Prions sirf protein se bane hote hain aur viroids sirf circular (gol) RNA se. Viroids kuch podon mein bimariyan paida karte hain; prions janwaron aur insaanon mein bimariyan paida karte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke prions aur viroids dono kuch podon mein infectious (phailne wali) bimariyan paida karte hain. Yeh sirf viroids ke liye sahi hai (jaise aloo ki potato spindle tuber disease). Prions podon mein nahi, janwaron aur insaanon mein bimariyan paida karte hain, jaise bher (sheep) mein scrapie, gaaye mein mad cow disease (BSE) aur insaan mein Creutzfeldt–Jakob disease.

Ek virus nucleic acid (DNA ya RNA) se bana hota hai jis ke gird protein ka ghilaaf (coat) hota hai. Viruses apna koi metabolism nahi chala sakte. Apni nakal banane (replicate karne) aur apne proteins banane ke liye yeh host cell par depend karte hain, jo poday, janwar ya bacteria ka cell ho sakta hai.

Viruses ki classification kai khasoosiyat par hoti hai: un ka genetic material, replication ka tareeqa (strategy), shakal (morphology), aur woh kin hosts ko infect karte hain. Viruses ki classification International Committee on Taxonomy of Viruses (ICTV) ke banaye hue usoolon (guidelines) ke mutabiq hoti hai.

blocks.title: Capsid
blocks.text: Virus ke nucleic acid ke gird protein ke ghilaaf ko capsid kehte hain. Neeche shakal (morphology) wali classification isi capsid ki shakal par hai.
Host range ki buniyad par classification

items: Animal viruses: janwaron ko infect karte hain, insaanon samet. Misaalein: influenza virus, rabies virus.
Plant viruses: podon ko infect karte hain. Misaalein: tobacco mosaic virus, potato virus X.
Bacteriophages: bacteria ko infect karte hain. Misaalein: T4 phage, lambda phage.
Archaea viruses: archaea ko infect karte hain. Misal: Sulfolobus spindle-shaped virus.
Helical viruses: in ka capsid helical (spring ya seerhi ki tarah ghoomta hua) hota hai jo nucleic acid ke gird lipta hota hai. Misaalein: tobacco mosaic virus, rabies virus.
Icosahedral viruses: in ka capsid symmetrical icosahedral shakal ka hota hai (20 tikoni satahon wala). Misaalein: adenoviruses, herpesviruses.

Complex viruses: in ki banawat complex hoti hai; aksar icosahedral aur helical dono features hote hain, aur kabhi tail (dum) jaisi mazeed banawatein bhi. Misal: bacteriophages (bacteria ko infect karne wale viruses).
Enveloped viruses: in ke capsid ke gird lipid ka bahar wala envelope (ghilaaf) hota hai jo host cell ki membrane se banta hai. Misaalein: influenza virus, HIV.
Non-enveloped (naked) viruses: in mein bahar ka lipid envelope nahi hota; yeh sirf capsid se bane hote hain jis ke andar nucleic acid hota hai. Misaalein: poliovirus, adenovirus.

blocks.alt: Viruses ki paanch buniyadi shaklein, naam ke saath: helical (pech-daar nucleic acid ke gird disc jaisi capsid units ka dher), icosahedral (bees satahon wala capsid, lambe fibres ke saath), complex (bacteriophage: kai-pehlu sar, dum aur dum ke fibres), enveloped (capsid ke gird kaanton wala envelope) aur non-enveloped (saada icosahedral capsid, chhote ubhaar).
blocks.caption: Figure 1.30: Viruses ki buniyadi shaklein (kitab ki Figure 1.30 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Helical virus mein capsid ki units nucleic acid ke gird seerhi (spiral) jaisi tarteeb mein hoti hain, jaise tobacco mosaic virus. Icosahedral capsid ki 20 tikoni satahein hoti hain, jaise adenovirus. Complex shakal mein icosahedral sar aur helical dum dono hote hain (bacteriophage). Enveloped virus ke capsid ke bahar host cell se liya hua lipid ka envelope hota hai jis par kaante (spikes) hain, jaise influenza; non-enveloped virus mein yeh envelope nahi hota, jaise poliovirus.

blocks.alt: Paanch virus particles ka 3D model, label ke saath: protein units ke kundal se bani helical chhari; bees tikoni satahon wala icosahedral capsid; complex bacteriophage jis ka icosahedral sar, dum ka ghilaaf aur dum ke reshe hain; enveloped virus jis ka icosahedral capsid spikes wale lipid envelope ke andar hai; aur bina envelope ka naked icosahedral capsid.
blocks.caption: Viruses ki buniyadi shaklein (Figure 1.30 ke mutabiq asal 3D model).
blocks.long_description: Helical: protein units nucleic acid ke gird lipat kar chhari banate hain. Icosahedral: bees tikoni satahon ka band khol. Complex: sar aur dum, jaise bacteriophage mein. Enveloped: capsid host cell se liye gaye lipid ghilaaf mein lipta hua. Non-enveloped: nanga capsid.

blocks.text: Genetic material ki buniyad par classification
1. DNA viruses: in ka genetic material DNA hai. Yeh DNA single-stranded (ssDNA, ek dhaage wala) ya double-stranded (dsDNA, do dhaagon wala) ho sakta hai. Misaalein:

items: dsDNA viruses: adenoviruses (saans ki naali ke infections), herpesviruses (herpes, chickenpox yani lakra kakra).
ssDNA viruses: parvoviruses (gastroenteritis, yani maide aur aanton ki sozish se dast aur ulti).

blocks.text: 2. RNA viruses: in ka genetic material RNA hai. Yeh RNA single-stranded (ssRNA) ya double-stranded (dsRNA) ho sakta hai. Misaalein:

items: ssRNA viruses: coronaviruses (COVID-19), influenza viruses (flu).
dsRNA viruses: rotaviruses (gastroenteritis).

blocks.text: Replication ke tareeqe ki buniyad par classification

items: Positive-sense RNA viruses: in ka RNA genome seedha host cell ke ribosomes par proteins mein translate hota hai. Misaalein: poliovirus, hepatitis C virus.
Negative-sense RNA viruses: in ka RNA genome pehle ek viral enzyme (RNA polymerase) ke zariye mRNA mein transcribe hota hai, phir translation hoti hai. Misaalein: rabies virus, Ebola virus.
Reverse transcribing viruses: yeh reverse transcriptase enzyme ki madad se ek DNA intermediate (beech ka DNA qadam) bana kar replicate karte hain. In ka genome RNA ya DNA ho sakta hai. Misaalein:
RNA genome: retroviruses, jaise HIV (AIDS paida karta hai).
DNA genome: hepadnaviruses, jaise hepatitis B virus.

blocks.title: Ek virus kai lists mein kyun aata hai
blocks.text: Chaaron classifications alag alag sawal poochti hain. Influenza virus host ke lihaz se animal virus hai, shakal ke lihaz se enveloped, genetic material ke lihaz se ssRNA virus, aur replication ke lihaz se negative-sense RNA virus. Adenovirus animal virus hai, icosahedral aur non-enveloped hai, aur dsDNA virus hai.

items: Viruses acellular hain, is liye kisi domain ya kingdom mein nahi: protein coat mein nucleic acid, apna metabolism nahi.
Prions (sirf protein) janwaron aur insaanon mein, aur viroids (sirf circular RNA) podon mein bimariyan paida karte hain; dono acellular hain.
Host range: animal, plant, bacteriophage, archaea viruses.
Shakal: helical, icosahedral, complex, enveloped, non-enveloped.
Genetic material: dsDNA, ssDNA, ssRNA, dsRNA.
Replication: positive-sense RNA, negative-sense RNA, reverse transcribing (RNA ya DNA genome).
Classification ke usool ICTV banata hai.

blocks.prompt: HIV ko chaaron buniyadon par classify karein, aur batayein ke bacteriophage shakal ke lihaz se complex kyun hai.
blocks.explanation: HIV: host ke lihaz se animal virus; shakal ke lihaz se enveloped; genetic material ke lihaz se RNA virus; replication ke lihaz se reverse transcribing virus (retrovirus). Bacteriophage mein icosahedral sar ke saath helical dum aur dum ke reshe (tail fibres) jaisi mazeed banawatein hoti hain, is liye woh complex hai.
